definitions.explanation: Silk fabric or fiber. Loanword from English, used especially in the context of fashion, lingerie, and modern products; the native word {絹|きぬ} is more traditional.

examples.japanese: シルクのスカーフを{買|か}った。
このブラウスはシルク{百|ひゃく}パーセントだ。
シルクの{下着|したぎ}は{肌触|はだざわ}りがよくて{涼|すず}しい。
examples.english: Silk underwear feels nice on the skin and is cool.

notes:
From English "silk." Used much more often than {絹|きぬ} in modern commercial contexts (clothing labels, beauty products, lingerie).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シルクのスカーフ: silk scarf
- シルクのブラウス: silk blouse
- シルク{百|ひゃく}パーセント: 100% silk
- {天然|てんねん}シルク: natural silk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絹|きぬ}: silk — the native Japanese word, used for traditional items (kimono, futon) and in more formal or literary contexts
